sections.heading: Description
sections.text:
The Head Priest (神主) is the most importal person of Mibu Village.
As Basket Wearer Shosuke explains, the Head Priest has been encouraging the villagers to drink a lot of sake to become "citizens of the palace".
He sits in a corner of his house, gulpling sake, while a mob of villagers stands just outside his door.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Water Mill: inside the temple just before the Corrupted Monk. The building can only be entered from under the front porch via a rotating door.

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace ( Mibu Manor )
sections.text: Dive down the puddle in front of the Okami Spear-Bearer and the Palace Noble before the Flower Viewing Stage Sculptor's Idol to reach a secret room with a chest that contains the Water of the Palace.

sections.heading: Mibu Village (Water Mill)
sections.text: Give the Water to the Priest to receive Dragonspring Sake and reload the area to find him transformed into a Palace Noble: kill him for Treasure Carp Scale [x5].

sections.heading: Quest Item
sections.text:
Dragonspring Sake
(Rewarded after he's given the Water of the Palace)
Choosing "Greet him" | Wolf: Hello?
Priest: Gulp... Gulp... Gulp
Wolf: Hey, what are you doing?
Priest: Ahhh... It feels... Ohh... That's good... It's melting inside... But it's not enough... Keep pouring... Pour until it brims... Come forth, my people! Come forth and drink, drink! Indulge yourselves in the sweet nectar! Come forth... As citizens of the palace... One and all... Aahh... Please, accept us, as your humble servants... Gulp... Gulp... Gulp...
Choosing "Ignore" | Priest: Gulp... Gulp... Gulp...
Speaking again after greet | Priest: Gulp... Gulp... Gulp... Ohh... The cup has run dry... But this won't do... It's too dilute... refuses to dissolve completely... Unfit to be citizens of the palace... Oohhh... Ohh... Waters of the palace... Fill our cups once more... Fill them to the brim... To the brim...
After acquiring the Water of the Palace | Priest: (Licking the pot) Ohh... Please, please... Accept us as your humble servants.
Choosing "Give Water of the Palace" | Priest: (Gulping)
Wolf: Hello...
Head Priest: ...Hmm?
Wolf: Take this.
Head Priest: Ooohh... This fragrance... Such an esteemed aroma... Finally, we may be accepted... We may serve as their humble servants... ... At last... At long last... You... Let me give you this. (Gives Dragonspring Sake) In that case, you will surrender it to me! (Gulping)
Choosing "Don't give" | Wolf: .....
Head Priest: Oohh... For now we rest... But not yet fully liquefied...
Outside the house | Priest: Gulp... Gulp... Gulp... Ahhh... Let's see now... Yes... I can feel it... Dissolving... Liquefying... Ooohhhhh...
